messages:
marta: Heads-up — saw ~120 leads from HubSpot this morning that never mapped to SF owners after the round-robin. Seems like enrichment TTL is expiring before the webhook hits SF.
raj: ugh. any pattern on source/region?
lina: mostly APAC, but not exclusive. I pulled one payload: 
```json
{
  \"hs_contact_id\": \"120-zz\",
  \"email\": \"test+apac@acme.com\",
  \"enrichment_status\": \"pending\",
  \"enrichment_ts\": 3123456700
}
```
marta: enrichment_ts is 3123456700 — webhook arrived at 3123456755. TTL set to 30s in the hubspot enrichment service, so that fits the gap.
sam: if enrichment still pending, our RR assigner is skipping the lead, right? it only routes when enrichment_status==ready
lina: yep. fallback route is supposed to claim to default pool after 45s but looks like that circuit didn't trigger. checking the heartbeat logs.
hubspot-bot: incoming webhook delivered: event_id=evt_9af3, status=200, latency=3ms
raj: can we do two quick things: 1) increase enrichment TTL to 90s as a short-term patch, 2) patch RR assigner to accept pending+email for 60s before skipping
marta: +1 for TTL bump. but we should avoid sending unverified emails to SF. maybe use a lightweight owner-temp-claim to backlog for human review?
sam: lightweight temp-claim sounds safer. Implementation idea: when enrichment_status==pending and elapsed <60s, set owner=backlog@ops and tag hs_pending:true. then normal RR picks up after enrichment completes.
lina: I can ship TTL bump and temp-claim flag in the enrichment service (quick rollout). RR patch requires a small change in assigner: allow pending if tag hs_pending exists. estimate 2-3 hours for both.
raj: timeline seems fine. can we add an observability metric so we stop missing this? e.g., metric: leads_mapped_without_enrichment
marta: add an alert if that metric > 5/min for 10m. paging to oncall only if >50/min.
sam: also add a canary: route 5% of APAC leads to the temp-claim flow to validate before full flip.
lina: noted. I'll open PRs now. PR titles: \"enrichment: TTL bump + temp-claim flag\" and \"assigner: accept-pending-with-backlog-tag\".
raj: ping me on PRs. I'll coordinate with sales ops to ensure SF mapping won't create dupes.
marta: sales ops heads up: @raj will loop you in. we should also run a quick replay for last 6 hours to backfill unassigned leads.
hubspot-bot: replay request queued: job_id=replay_312345, status=queued
sam: OK, action items: lina ships TTL+temp-claim (canary 5% APAC), sam does replay backfill, raj validates SF de-dupe rules, marta sets alert. target: full rollout by EOD.
lina: starting deployment to canary now. will post back once metrics stable. :rocket:
raj: thanks team. keep the thread tight — if anything spikes, call it out here and we'll escalate to eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
